# GGIR numerical oracle

These synthetic fixtures were generated by the unmodified `HASIB()` function from
GGIR **3.3-9**, commit `1a849d174ca3b3649267d9d7487fa75ab8c00c40`, with R 4.5.3.
They contain no participant data. Inputs cover quiet, active, varying, missing,
partial-minute and impulse cases; expected values include weighted scores and
binary states at every minute, including boundaries.

`generate_ggir_fixture.R` sources the pinned R file and extracts its own local
helpers. Before calling HASIB it applies `g.sib.det`'s NA-to-zero operation.
No Python implementation is used to construct the oracle. GGIR's sleep=1 is
converted to this repository's wake=1 when saving the fixture.

Regenerate from the repository root:

```bash
Rscript tests/generate_ggir_fixture.R /path/to/GGIR/R/HASIB.R
```

Source: https://github.com/wadpac/GGIR/blob/1a849d174ca3b3649267d9d7487fa75ab8c00c40/R/HASIB.R
